requirement_vague: Reset a password with an invalid reset token and confirm the reset is rejected.

omissions.description: There is no reset-password endpoint in the code. The requirement calls for a POST endpoint that accepts {"new_password": "changethis", "token": "invalid"} and returns HTTP 400 with {"detail": "Invalid token"} when the token is invalid.
omissions.reasoning: Searching the entire codebase, there is no route defined for password reset (e.g., /reset-password or /password-recovery). The api_router has no such endpoint registered, so the reset-password operation cannot be called at all.
